title: Qwen3.6-27B pair-produced Q4 gate with shared Q6-QKV activation leaf

candidate.roles: 24 linear-attention layers whose QKV is Q6T16 and gate is Q4T16
candidate.baseline: retained Q6 source-F16/rocBLAS chain followed by exact Q4T16 gate
candidate.candidate: unchanged Q6 chain followed by adjacent-pair-produced Q4 source-F16/rocBLAS gate, reusing Q6's FP16 activation
candidate.arithmetic: Q6 unchanged; Q4 uses the already-quality-gated source-F16 boundary and exact pair producer
candidate.admission_scope_if_qualified: Qwen3.6-27B gfx1100 rows 512-2047 only; rows >=2048, decode, verifier/MTP, peer backends, registry misses, and other model/shape scopes retain exact Q4T16 gate

protocol.command_template: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<1 XTX|0 W7900> HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1100 HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. /home/lhl/mambaforge/envs/therock/bin/python /tmp/qwen36_q6qkv_q4gate_pair_screen.py --device <xtx|w7900> --rows 512,1024 --warmups 3 --samples 15 --output <output>
protocol.constraint: reuse only the current activation, weight-tile, and output-tile scratch planes; add no allocation or payload

reconciliation.prior_gate_result: The earlier scalar-producer Q4 gate route improved XTX M512 but missed W7900 M512 by 0.047% with 7/15 wins and was removed.
reconciliation.material_difference: This leaf uses the later exact adjacent-pair Q4 producer and consumes the complete Q6-QKV plus Q4-gate operation boundary so the FP16 activation is produced only once. It is not a repeat of the scalar singleton route.
reconciliation.why_no_4k_screen: The optimization objective is the remaining M512 gap, and the previous gate source-F16 route already passed 4K while full-Q has a known exact M2048/4K ceiling. Initial runtime admission must therefore fail closed at rows 2048 and keep the current exact gate there.

decision: Retain as a runtime-unwired leaf. Add a row-bounded Q4 K5,120/N6,144 policy only at anchors 512:2048 and 1024:512 with a generic maximum row of 2047, select the exact adjacent-pair producer, and rely on the existing source-F16 pair ABI to share activation with the already-admitted Q6 QKV peer. Require focused route tests, complete category quality, full-engine cross-board qualification, decode/memory/MTP safeguards, and named production tracing before publication.
